tests.title: The diagnostic flash read log: reads of a range with their values, SR1 as read, CCR1 and CR1 writes, CR1 at power-on and reset

note: Run with G7250_FLASH_READLOG=0x080E0000-0x080E0FFF G7250_FLASH_READLOG_BOOTS=1-2 (m1_smoke step [13]). The image is firmware-tests/bench/net_test.c (its F commands on sector 7).
